description: Header file defining the RegionSamplingThread class for surface region sampling in Android's SurfaceFlinger, including timing configurations, listener management, and sampling operations.

classes.name: RegionSamplingThread
classes.description: Manages region sampling for surface layers, including listener registration, sampling execution, and thread management.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener for luma notifications in a specified sampling area.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Unregisters a listener to stop receiving luma notifications.

methods.name: onCompositionComplete
methods.description: Signals that composition is complete and sampling can proceed, with an optional deadline.

methods.name: doSample
methods.description: Performs the sampling operation, possibly within a deadline.

methods.name: captureSample
methods.description: Captures a sample from the current frame buffer.

methods.name: threadMain
methods.description: Main loop for the sampling thread.

methods.name: binderDied
methods.description: Handles the death of a binder object.

methods.name: checkForStaleLuma
methods.description: Checks and updates stale luminance data.

methods.name: sampleBuffer
methods.description: Generates a buffer of sampled luminance data.
